notes.title: Chiki-Chiki 1.0.1 is Available.
notes.content:
Hello, let's celebrate Steam's Remote Play Together 2024 with a little Chiki-Chiki update !

We talked about two upcoming features in two different patches... Finally we did a two in one. While you're progressing in the Grand Lagoon Cup, you will be able to unlock new achievements. Each one of them will also unlock new skin for your Chikis!

On the menu :
• 5 achievements
• 6 skins

Enjoy <3 !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44288605/b5f59d949c09f1bb2c34720cfac41b3fd2464416.png[/img]

notes.title: Chiki-Chiki's out !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44288605/b5f59d949c09f1bb2c34720cfac41b3fd2464416.png[/img]

[h3]We are proud to share with you the launch of our first title ![/h3]

[b]Today's launch day for Chiki-Chiki, the first game by Saltitude, a young french studio. We hope you'll have a lot of fun ! =][/b]

We poured all our heart to deliver a charming and funny world, while also making sure to deliver a nicely polished product for this game full of physiqued interactions and a unique controller !


Have fun ! ❤️



[h3]What's to come for Chiki-Chiki[/h3]

We will not stop here ! We're already preparing for 2 upcoming updates at the start of 2024 :

• [b]Steam achievments[/b]
We were a little short on time for the launch, but you'll soon get nice achievments to reward the most adventurous fishes !

• [b]New Skins[/b] 
New fishes for you to play, following a french game festival, we collected tons of drawings and some of them really deserve to figure in the game =D
